gaps.lead: They say the new bridge will cut journey times in half.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ in half by the new bridge.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: journey times are said to be cut.

gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ suitcase that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective becomes such (+a) + adjective + noun: such a heavy suitcase.

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.
